Notes: makeshift pen in which, e.g. new-born calf was held.
Notes: cream boiled and reduced to make an ointment used in treating burns.
Notes: tittering.

Notes: nibbling of fish at hook.

Notes: to suck (a lollipop or something similar).

Notes: Applecross word for a ‘softy’.
